status: PROPOSED CONNECTION FAMILIES; CUT GEOMETRY UNRESOLVED
scope: Existing 104-member geometry and IDs are retained unchanged. This review does not introduce fabrication sizes or certify the fitted mesh.

representative_corner.finding: At P0 centre X=4.5720000267 m, the nominal R0 hip envelope spans Y=2.1236501249 to 2.3894218811 m. The nominal ring spans Y=2.1844000816 to 2.3875999451 m. The hip therefore crosses the full ring depth in the current reconstruction.
representative_corner.interpretation: The hip underside is about 2.39173 inches below the ring underside at this plane. This is a model diagnostic, not a proposed notch depth or roof-raising dimension.
representative_corner.next: Resolve the source roof bearing datum and approved load path before replacing cuts or propagating a corner detail.

families.title: Supported ring-beam laps
families.proposal: Consider supported laps or another designed ring connection over the posts. Each intersecting ring member needs a defined bearing area; continuity and uplift restraint require a separate connection design.
families.hold: Current 22.5° plan miters define only a geometric seam. Resolve the post-head bearing, roof interference, remaining section, grain direction, ring forces and assembly access before selecting lap depth or fasteners.

families.title: Housed radial tie tenons
families.proposal: Review a housed shoulder and tenon arrangement that transfers the intended force without treating the saved keyed partition as a structural connection.
families.hold: Confirm whether each tie end carries tension, compression, shear, or combined forces. Resolve net section, tension restraint, end distances, peg specification, mortise access and insertion direction. No tenon or peg dimensions are assigned.

families.title: Housed brace tenons
families.proposal: Review shoulders or housings for compressive bearing and a compatible tenon for location and required restraint. Coordinate adjacent mortises at the post head.
families.hold: Check brace force direction, bearing area, post/ring retained wood, grain and splitting, then tool and raising access. Allow for shrinkage so the tenon does not bottom out before its shoulder bears. Do not substitute peg action for designed shear bearing.

families.title: Hip bearing seats
families.proposal: Develop a bearing-seat detail only after the roof datum and corner load path are agreed. Inspect the P0 corner as the first representative study.
families.hold: Current hip geometry crosses the full depth of the ring at the representative corner. Do not deepen a notch, trim away the ring, or move the roof by an unapproved amount to clear the collision. Resolve retained hip section, seat bearing and uplift/rotation restraint.

families.title: Shallow secondary-rafter seats
families.proposal: Review shallow seats aligned with a verified roof support plane, with defined bearing and any required uplift restraint.
families.hold: The secondary layout is approximate. Confirm spacing, loads, section, grain, retained depth and clearance from neighboring joints. Verify each eventual cut member remains one connected solid; do not delete detached fragments to manufacture a pass.

families.title: Accessible cupola closure
families.proposal: Select a closing connection that can be inserted with the surrounding members in place. Develop a connection-specific raising and temporary-support sequence.
families.hold: Reject trapped keys and closed loops that cannot be assembled. Verify actual swept insertion paths, handling clearance, tool access, temporary stability and release criteria. The explode slider is not an erection simulation.

inputs_required: Original dimensioned source and joint details; nominal versus actual sections
Roof bearing elevations and intended load paths
Species, grade, moisture condition and shrinkage assumptions
Site loads and engineered member/connection forces
Connection dimensions, edge/end distances and permitted reductions
Manufacturing clearance, tooling and inspection tolerances
Temporary bracing, access and connection-specific assembly sequence
provenance: Documented source callouts, model interpretations and user design changes remain distinct in model-data.source_dimensions.
The 30 ft model interpretation is opposite perimeter post-center vertices; it is not the historical 30 ft finished-interior across-flat adaptation.
The changed main overhang remains 2 ft 6 in TOTAL beyond the modeled outer post envelope, measured perpendicular to each wall.
No site north is assigned in this model. Temporary works are not present among these 104 permanent pieces.
validation: No structural-capacity, manufacturing-fit or erection-path pass is claimed. Prior fit-audit numbers are preserved as historical metadata.
